stock_power.observed_result: Returned to stock Android after fastboot command transport stalled
stock_power.repeatability: One reported successful recovery; not independently stress-tested

newkernel_source_findings.long_press: KEYBOARD_MTK and ONEKEY_REBOOT_NORMAL_MODE/OTHER_MODE enabled; LPRST_TD=2 maps to 14 seconds in Kconfig. kpd probe calls long_press_reboot_function_setting; PMIC wrappers ignore write result. Not runtime proof.
newkernel_source_findings.reset: machine_restart uses arm_pm_restart if present, else do_kernel_restart. mtk_wdt registers a restart handler or reboot notifier; normal RESTART takes no recovery/bootloader command. Handler hardware/firmware result untested.
newkernel_source_findings.hardware_watchdog: MEDIATEK_WATCHDOG=y; DOUGLAS and GIZA are disabled, so mtk_wdt_probe calls mtk_wdt_stop. No diagnostic watchdog device is opened/armed. A user-space deadline is not an independent hardware watchdog.
newkernel_source_findings.usb: usb20.c allocates musb-hdrc with PLATFORM_DEVID_NONE; candidate UDC string musb-hdrc follows source, not a runtime observation.
